exam.title: Professional Data Engineer
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; Google recommends three or more years of industry experience including at least one year designing and managing Google Cloud data solutions. Practice governed contracts, batch/stream semantics, BigQuery/lake/platform modeling, Dataflow/Dataproc/Dataform/Composer, migration/CDC, BI/ML/RAG preparation, sharing, capacity/cost, CI/CD, observability, backfill/replay and tested recovery.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Preparing and using data for analysis (~15%)

review.notes: All five detailed current domains are mapped through governed data contracts, batch/stream semantics, storage/warehouse/lake/platform decisions, BI/ML/RAG preparation, sharing, orchestration and production capacity/observability/recovery. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 checks are included. All eight URLs are cataloged: seven reachable and O'Reilly automation-blocked; none missing or broken. No proprietary bank, recalled item or copied course content is used.

findings.title: A missing lifecycle record is not an objective change
findings.evidence: The objective digest is unchanged while no prior lifecycle digest exists; canonical page has three distinct certification/renewal routes.
findings.recommendation: Initialize the reviewed lifecycle baseline and preserve before/accepted/post observations; distinguish standard,renewalexam anddesignatedSkills routes.
findings.resolution: Initialize the reviewed lifecycle baseline and preserve before/accepted/post observations; distinguish standard,renewalexam anddesignatedSkills routes.

findings.title: A committed-once result does not guarantee a single external action or complete window
findings.evidence: Transforms can run repeatedly/concurrently; external effects and late records have separate contracts.
findings.recommendation: Add source/engine/sink/business boundaries and require a real sink contract; explain pane and drop accounting.
findings.resolution: Add source/engine/sink/business boundaries and require a real sink contract; explain pane and drop accounting.

findings.title: Duplicate suppression and source order solve different replay failures
findings.evidence: Delivery is at least once and unordered;source-specific metadata and BigQuery internal sequence support correct merging.
findings.recommendation: Teach entitykey,eventID,epoch/sourceorder,tombstone and backfill reconciliation; execute an explicitly limited SQLite exercise.
findings.resolution: Teach entitykey,eventID,epoch/sourceorder,tombstone and backfill reconciliation; execute an explicitly limited SQLite exercise.

findings.title: Default streams and application-created offset/commit contracts differ
findings.evidence: Default stream is at least once;offsets and pending atomic commits are separate features.
findings.recommendation: Explain stream-scoped write semantics and finalization versus commit without claiming business-event deduplication.
findings.resolution: Explain stream-scoped write semantics and finalization versus commit without claiming business-event deduplication.

findings.title: CDC order and freshness require explicit configuration and capacity
BigQuery declared keys do not enforce data correctness
findings.evidence: Constraints are unenforced and can inform query optimization;violatedconstraintsriskwrongresults.
findings.recommendation: Require non-null/uniqueness/referential checks and grain-aware joins; demonstrate150to250centfanoutandrepairinSQLite.
findings.resolution: Require non-null/uniqueness/referential checks and grain-aware joins; demonstrate150to250centfanoutandrepairinSQLite.

findings.title: Depending on a table alone does not gate on its assertions
findings.recommendation: Teach explicit direct assertion dependencies and per-action override,withnegativefixture/compiledgraphlab.
findings.resolution: Teach explicit direct assertion dependencies and per-action override,withnegativefixture/compiledgraphlab.

findings.title: Task retries need a stable input interval
findings.recommendation: Bind inputs and outputs to data interval/version,use sharedstorage references,andvalidatebusinesskey/versiontransaction.
findings.resolution: Bind inputs and outputs to data interval/version,use sharedstorage references,andvalidatebusinesskey/versiontransaction.

findings.title: Current naming and metadata context should not silently replace exam scope
A key must support both access pattern and traffic distribution
Historical data access is not an unlimited restore or ordinary fail-safe query
Regional failover includes capacity,ACLs and schedules
